title: Rename Window Panels To Panes And Corner Panels To Panels
description: Rename the UI terminology for the movable/floating window-like chrome elements from "panel" to "pane" (e.g. WindowActionPanel-style components, related types, CSS classes, translation keys), while renaming the screen-corner-docked UI elements to "panel" (keeping/aligning them on the term "panel"). Sweep framework/renderer/react, ui/js/react, compose, coda and related translation/locale schema (EN/DE) bundles for all affected identifiers, types, CSS class names, and translation keys. Update all call sites consistently. No legacy aliases or compatibility shims — rename everything at once per repo greenfield rules.
summary:
Renamed the per-window floating "Actions rail" chrome from "Panel" to "Pane" terminology across the shell/UI stack, while leaving the screen-corner-docked panel system (CornerPanel/PanelDock/PANEL_TABS/etc.) untouched since it already correctly uses "panel".

Renamed in framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx and its test mirror framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts: WindowActionPanel -> WindowActionPane (+ Props), ActionPanelState -> ActionPaneState, ActionPanelSlice -> ActionPaneSlice, actionPanelReducer -> actionPaneReducer, the actionPanel ShellState field -> actionPane, SET_ACTION_PANEL_FOLDED/EXPANDED action types -> SET_ACTION_PANE_FOLDED/EXPANDED, windowActionPanelNode -> windowActionPaneNode, actionPanelExpandedByWindowId(Ref)/actionPanelFoldedByWindowId/actionPanelStagedArgsByKey(Ref) -> actionPane* equivalents, doc-comment @link references, and the //#region markers.

Renamed in ui/js/react/index.tsx: WindowActionPanelChrome/Props -> WindowActionPaneChrome/Props, the data-slot="window-action-panel(-chrome/-unfold/-fold/-overlay/-body)" DOM attributes -> "window-action-pane-*", windowActionPanelOverlayClass/OverlayFoldedClass/BodyClass -> windowActionPane*, and WindowConfig.actionPanel -> actionPane.

Renamed in cad/renderer/js/index.tsx: floatingPanelAsideClass -> floatingPaneAsideClass, SelectionAttributesPanel/Props -> SelectionAttributesPane/Props, SelectionPropertiesPanel/Props -> SelectionPropertiesPane/Props, ModelStatsPanel/Props -> ModelStatsPane/Props, plus two prose doc-comments ("the floating panel" -> "the floating pane").

Left untouched (confirmed via an exhaustive prior audit): the entire corner-docked component family (Panel/CornerPanel/PanelDock/PanelTabNode/PanelTabBar/LeftPanel/RightPanel/BottomPanel/MobilePanel), FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, ui.panel.*/ui.panelToggle.* translation keys (EN/DE), Rust PanelGroup/PanelVisibility/.panel_tab(...) registrations across all plugins, and the generic bg-panel/z-index "Level" design token (shared surface-color primitive, not a component name) — all of these already correctly use "panel" per the corner-panel half of this rename and were deliberately left alone to avoid conflating them with the generic token.

Verified: framework-renderer-react test suite 147/147 passing (no change from baseline). ui-react typecheck shows the same 78 pre-existing baseline errors before and after (zero new errors introduced, confirmed via git stash diff). cad-js-renderer test suite has the same 16 pre-existing failures (unrelated typology/color assertions) before and after (confirmed via git stash diff) — one of the 16, "ModelStatsPane resolves shape stat labels...", is the renamed test and its failure pre-dates this rename.

Not touched: compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/index.ts and the MULTILINGUAL-AND-TERMINOLOGY-PARITY-SWEEP ticket files, both already modified/uncommitted before this ticket started (another concurrent session's in-progress work).
